entities.summary: Domenico Crescentino Marinozzi, OFMCap, was an Italian Roman Catholic Capuchin priest, missionary, and member of the Order of Friars Minor Capuchin. He served as the Prefect Apostolic and Vicar Apostolic of the Apostolic Vicariate of Soddo, in Soddo, Wolayita Zone, Ethiopia, from 1972 until 2007.
